headline: Pakistan co-hosts UN's first policy dialogue on tokenization, making history | Express News
summary: Pakistan co-hosted the UN's first policy dialogue on tokenization. Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said Pakistan is playing an important role in shaping the future of the digital financial system.
why: Tokenization applies blockchain technology to represent financial assets, and international policy frameworks shape how banks and investors adopt it.
